name: AB+ citation-grounding pipeline
description: Deterministic verification of quotations against their source documents, built for the bibliography of the Theseus' Ship papers. The pipeline extracts text from a source PDF, then decides in code — never by asking a language model — whether each proposed quotation actually occurs in that source, on which page, and whether the proposer's claimed page agrees. A quotation that cannot be located is a hard failure and does not reach the deliverable. The design point is that the one guarantee the pipeline offers is mechanical: quote presence is a string containment test, not a judgement.

isPartOf.name: Theseus' Ship: Longevity of Research Software in the Humanities
